name: Heal
description: Level 6 Abjuration (Doctor, Druid) Casting Time: Action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous Choose a creature that you can see within range. Positive energy washes through the target, restoring 70 Health. This spell also ends the Blinded, Deafened, and Poisoned conditions on the target. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 10 for each spell slot level above 6.
